sections.Profile:
The "Michael Jordan" pinball machine by Data East, released in 1992, is a rare custom-built game with only seven units produced. Designed to raise money for charity, the game is based on the "Lethal Weapon 3" pinball framework and features basketball-themed elements, including a "Be Like Mike" music tie-in. The machine has two flippers, one ramp, and a three-ball multiball mode.
